_note: The Up next chain (redesign v2, Navigation rules 5): each public tool's slug on the site (/tools/<slug>/), the lab that builds it, the short question its Up next card shows, and the tool that comes after it. films: each watch page's one Up next tool (hash: an optional section of it to open, such as money-then-now's #this-year, the only hash a tool reads). The site's sync-labs check fails if a slug here has no dist. listed: a tool with "listed": false is built and live at its address but unlisted (until Mo's firm compliance OKs it): it is nobody's Up next, the site links to it nowhere and it carries noindex. A missing listed means true. A door (a tool's next or a film's next) to an unlisted tool follows that tool's own next, so flipping the one flag is the only edit. The resolved target is written as to (desk-page.mjs resolvedNext); the site reads only to.
